ios.desc:
Self Sport makes it effortless to track your life, reflect, and find more mindfulness, all without disrupting your daily routine. 

Designed for those who want to adopt journaling and other wellness practices but don’t have the time for complex new habits, Self Sport is your personal life tracker, providing seamless integration into daily life with intelligent tools to boost gratitude, mindfulness, and self-awareness.

Like a fitness tracker for your thoughts and experiences, Self Sport keeps things simple, fast, and meaningful. 

No need to overhaul your schedule—just log key moments across 12 essential life categories and let the app handle the rest.

Key Features:

- Quick & Easy Life Tracking: Capture moments in seconds across key areas like Health, Family, Work, and more. It’s like a daily journal, but designed to fit effortlessly into your busy life. Bulleted, enriched with imagery and videos as an option, easy.

- Streaks, Goals, Metrics: See the balance of your life across life's primary domains, set goals for focusing on life areas and track streaks.


- [Pro Feature] AI-Powered Wellness Sessions: Automatically generate Gratitude Statements, Affirmations, and Intention Statements based on your current lifestyle and goals. It’s a personalized way to bring more positivity and focus into your day.


-  [Pro Feature] Self Mind Chat: Gain insights into your life from unique perspectives—whether you want inspiration, humor, or deep reflection, Self Sport’s AI chat has you covered.


- Integrated & Fast: The app is designed to fit around you, making journaling and mindfulness painless and integrated into your routine.
Perfect for those who want to boost self-awareness, live with more gratitude, and keep track of their personal growth without disrupting their life.

___________

Now that all of the marketing boilerplate is out of the way, we want to add this too. 

We built Self Sport because we needed Self Sport. Pure and simple. In our experience, modern life is chaotic by nature. You can't really escape it, and you shouldn't have to change your entire routine to become more mindful, meditative, "well" and relaxed. We needed something that provided the mindset and performance benefits of wellness practices but less woo woo and less intensive to adopt. That's Self Sport.

quotes.text:
I'm not a developer (or designer) by trade but have always wanted to make something like this. Over the past year, around having a baby and the day-job, I've been learning to code and figuring things out. Today, Self Sport goes live in the app store.

It's the worst kind of app. It's something I needed, I knew would help me, and I guessed may help others. Its focus is on helping drive a stronger sense of self, and a richer life.

--- Summary --

Self Sport is lifestyle tracker that functions somewhat like a journal, but more incrementally and short form similar to tweets. It uses a social ‘feed’ feature to allow users to get inspiration for various parts of their lives (fitness, love life, friends, family, goals, etc.) from the community’s activity, while avoiding other social features (following, likes, comments, etc.) to mitigate the negative sides of social posting.

iPhone only for now. Launched today.

Would love to chat about it with you all.
